LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Expiry and Thread Safety.

This module provides a robust implementation of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache
that supports time-to-live (TTL) expiration for cached items. It is designed to be
thread-safe, making it suitable for concurrent access in multi-threaded applications.

Features:
    - LRU eviction policy: When the cache reaches its maximum capacity, the least
      recently used item is evicted to make space for new items.
    - TTL Expiry: Each cached item can have an associated time-to-live (TTL).
      Items that exceed their TTL are considered expired and are automatically
      removed upon access or during periodic cleanup.
    - Thread Safety: All public methods are thread-safe, ensuring consistent
      behavior in concurrent environments.
    - Configurable Parameters: Users can customize cache capacity, default TTL,
      and cleanup intervals.

      edge cases, and concurrency scenarios using pytest.

    value = cache.get("key1")

    # Remove a specific key

    # Clear all entries

    # Get cache statistics
